killedBy: the screen gate: the declaration reaches the verdict, not just the helper (issue #861) lets a DECLARED error through to the ordinary measurement comparison
why: Severs the declaration from the verdict while leaving the helper it calls fully tested. `judgePageErrors` reads `state?.pageError`, so a caller that loses the state does not throw -- it silently takes the undeclared branch, and `screen.startup.entry-unparseable` goes back to being a state the gate can neither accept nor pass. This is the composition a unit test on the pure function cannot reach: when the entry was written, reverting judgeState's whole declared path left all 26 tests in the file green.
